expects.query: Deploy the VSS **base** profile on {{platform}}, using the `/vss-deploy-profile` skill end-to-end and autonomously.
checks: `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8000/health` returns exit 0 (Agent REST API responsive)

`docker inspect vss-rtvi-vlm --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}'` prints `healthy` (RT-VLM serves the VLM for the base profile, so a crash-looping or unhealthy container means no VLM even when every other service is up)

The model id returned by `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8018/v1/models` matches the `VLM_NAME` value in `developer-profiles/dev-profile-base/generated.env` (a mismatch makes the agent request a model RT-VLM does not serve, and every summarization returns 400)
